Maya (AE): Intro: ZenWave wants an auth POC. Must-haves from their security questionnaire: EU-only residency, BYOK (customer HSM), SCIM audit trail for 12 months, and domain verification across business units. Also asked for a committed Dedicated quote if reserved capacity needed. Can SE/PS/Sec triage?
Dev (SE): Quick check: IdPs = Okta + Azure AD? SP-initiated preferred? Do they need OIDC for modern apps? Also confirm SCIM scope (users + groups + custom attrs).
Maya (AE): They said Okta + Azure; SP-initiated is fine; OIDC helpful. SCIM = full lifecycle + groups + custom attr `costCenter`. Domain list: zenwave.com, eu.zenwave.io, partner.zenwave.net.
Dev (SE): Tech notes to share: SAML HTTP-POST/Redirect; RSA-SHA256 signatures; optional encrypted assertions (AES-256). SCIM v2 with PATCH + delta tokens. Example PATCH to add group member: `PATCH /scim/v2/Groups/{id}` payload small. We can emit provisioning events to SIEM or S3. Default rate limit 60rpm; Dedicated can raise it.
Oscar (Pricing): Ballpark Dedicated tiers: small (2x) ~$12k/mo, mid (4x) ~$23k/mo, large (8x) ~$44k/mo. BYOK/HSM + EU residency + extended audit retention are add-ons. I'll draft 3 committed scenarios after we get throughput estimates.
Lina (Security): From questionnaire: we can provide SOC2 Type II, BYOK via customer KMS/HSM (AWS/GCP/Azure), yearly pen-test summary. For tamper-evident audit trails we provide signed daily manifests and S3 export; 12mo retention available as add-on. If they require strict in-country controls suggest Dedicated in EU region or Private deploy (6-8 week ETA).
infra-bot: POC workspace created: https://console.redwood.example/tenancy/poc-zenwave (id: poc-zen-202409). Invite sent to poc@zenwave.com :white_check_mark:
Maya (AE): Timeline: kickoff next Tue, 10-business-day POC, decision in 21 days. Owners: Dev = SE, Oscar = pricing, Lina = security. I'll request Okta metadata + sample CSV of users with `costCenter`.
Dev (SE): Will prepare a short tech appendix (SAML metadata template, SCIM mapping, domain enforcement sample) and drop to shared drive.
Oscar (Pricing): I'll post pricing scenarios once we have rough token/month and peak qps.
Lina (Security): Uploading compliance pack and BYOK guide; will include short canned answers for their questionnaire.
Maya (AE): Thanks team 64f. Sending request to ZenWave for metadata + CSV now.
(threads end)
